question.text: Himalaya Credit Opportunities Fund (Cat II) exits a LISTED equity position (held 8 months, STT paid) on 15 September 2024 with a gain of INR 2 crore. Assume the gain has capital-gains character and is passed through to a resident LP. At what rate is this STCG taxed in the LP's hands (ignoring surcharge and cess)?

answer.text: 20% under Section 111A, as amended for transfers on/after 23-07-2024.
Slab rate applicable to the LP.

explanation.text: The Logic: Listed equity held 12 months or less with STT paid produces STCG under Section 111A. For transfers on or after 23 July 2024, the STCG rate on STT-paid listed equity is 20%. A 15 September 2024 exit falls after the cut-off, so 20% applies. Pass-through preserves capital-gains character, so the LP's tax = 2 crore x 20% (plus surcharge and cess as applicable). The Trap: Option A applies the pre-23-07-2024 rate of 15%. Option B misclassifies the 8-month holding as LTCG (LTCG requires a holding period above 12 months for listed equity). Option D applies ordinary slab rates and ignores the special rate under Section 111A. Note: The workbook supports pass-through character retention, listed equity held 12 months or less as STCG, and a 20% STCG rate on STT-paid listed equity after 23 July 2024.
